Insight Panel
Automatically generated observations from this reporting period

Leads increased consistently every month, from 146 in June to 314 in August.

Organic SEO performance continued to improve, with average position moving from 8.3 to 5.2.

Meta Ads delivered the highest lead contribution, generating 375 of the 678 total leads (55%).

Social Media successfully increased engagement and followers, growing engagement rate from 2% to 5.4%.

Marketing ROI remained above 400% throughout the period, peaking at 435% in August.

Revenue and Gross Profit showed continuous growth, more than doubling from June to August.

Customer Acquisition Cost remained efficient, averaging Rp6,696 against an average order value well above cost.

Campaign performance improved month by month as budget scaling was matched by conversion efficiency.
